# opencode-dashscope-imagegen

> OpenCode plugin that adds an image_generate tool for text-to-image generation with Alibaba DashScope models (qwen-image-2.0, qwen-image-3.0, wan2.7-image)

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, LLM-friendly index of the project.

- [README.md](./README.md): install, run and test instructions

## Key facts

- Install: `npm install opencode-dashscope-imagegen`
- Test: `npm run test`
